hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for prediction market pools (YES/NO share tokens) that implements VALS dynamic fees calculated as e^[λ*(Δx/L)*σ]-1 from a backend-signed toxic velocity parameter. Every swap requires a valid ECDSA-signed SignedSigma in hookData; fee proceeds are routed to share token holders via YieldDistributor rather than to LPs.
